mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying fair conditions and 70 degrees around Harriet Park. Make sure to look up tonight at 10:21 PM for a clear five-minute view of the International Space Station rising in the Northwest.

In city news, Verona is advancing its environmental initiatives. Rooftop solar panels have been installed at the City Center, the Fire Department, and the Century School Park band shell to reduce carbon emissions. Additionally, Mayor Diaz signed the Mayors Monarch Pledge to create native habitats for pollinators, and the city is sharing tips to help residents start composting yard and food waste at home.

Local events kick off today with Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, July 21st, you can test your skills at Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Louie. Then on Wednesday, enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.

In police news, the weekly report highlights several incidents. On Monday night, July 13th, police responded to a call regarding a vehicle stuck on a large rock, which resulted in the driver being arrested for operating while intoxicated.

For dessert today, Culver's is serving up Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. They are open until 10:00 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to grab some. If you cannot make it, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Caramel Twist.
